title: Team Capacity Requisition Log — Q4 2026
summary: Working intake register used by infra + platform teams to log GPU/accelerator requisitions for Q4 2026. Focus is on short-term sprint requests, medium-term reservations for Dedicated workloads, and region placement constraints to balance utilization and support SLAs.
notes: This sheet is intentionally lightweight: one-line descriptions per request, dependency tags, and a short approvals column. Use ticket links for detailed spec. Triage cadence: infra squad reviews Tues/Thurs; final allocation decisions recorded here. If request is high priority and cross-team, flag in Slack #infra-capacity and tag Priya.

triage_notes: Triage rules (short): 1) critical -> immediate escalation to infra lead and purchase. 2) high -> try to satisfy from short-term pool or move to weekend maintenance window. 3) medium/low -> schedule into weekly bunting window. Always evaluate region affinity and inter-team blockers. Include expected token/sec or qps if request is >4 GPUs.
next_steps: - Before allocation: confirm billing center and tag (cost center). - If H100 requested, confirm availability window with cloud provider and record expected hours. - Notify requestor and update ticket with exact node IDs once scheduled. - Run post-mortem for any failed canary or region failover tasks.
last_update_summary: 2026-11-15 review: capacity-ops reserved 2 A100 for REC-402 and approved embedding rebuild; still pending vendor confirmation for H100 block for DED-88. Region balancing suggested: move one us-east1 test to eu-west1 if bandwidth permits.
how_to_use: Add new line per request, populate ticket link, tag priority, and ping infra-capacity on Slack for any high/critical requests. Use ticket to attach detailed runbook and expected metrics. For multi-region tests, list primary then fallback.
